semiconductor_relevance: High — AMIES Technology Co., Ltd. provides specialized equipment for critical semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AMIES Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, offering a range of advanced machinery for front-end and advanced packaging processes. Their product portfolio includes laser annealing equipment for integrated circuits and power devices, overlay measurement tools, and wafer defect detection systems. They also cater to the compound semiconductor and flat panel display markets with specialized lithography and measurement equipment.
capabilities: Front-end laser annealing equipment for integrated circuits and power devices
Overlay measurement and wafer defect detection equipment
Wafer-level and square plate advanced packaging lithography machines
LED and compound semiconductor lithography machines
